nodes.description: uint8 public gType = 3; game type identifier stored in contract state.
uint8 public fee = 10; commission percentage used in prize distribution math.
uint public game; current game number, also set from block.number in startGame.
uint public ticketPrice = 0.05 ether; required msg.value for buyTicket.
uint public newPrice; pending ticket price applied on next startGame.
uint public allTimeJackpot; cumulative jackpot accumulator updated in pickTheWinner.
uint public allTimePlayers; cumulative player counter updated in pickTheWinner.
uint public paidToPartners; amount already paid to partners, reset and reused in payout math.
bool public isActive; gate for buyTicket and startGame.
bool public toogleStatus; pending game status switch flag.
uint[] public games; array of all games (never written in this contract).
mapping(uint => uint) jackpot; per-game pot incremented in buyTicket and drained in pickTheWinner.
mapping(uint => address[]) players; per-game participant list, pushed with msg.sender.
iOwnable public ownable; external access-control contract consulted by onlyOwner.
iCryptolottoStatsAggregator public stats; external aggregator called in pickTheWinner.
iCryptolottoReferral public referralInstance; external referral system queried for partners/percent.
address public fundsDistributor; recipient of balance via low-level call with 30000 gas.
msg.sender; caller address used as player, participant and access-control subject.
block.timestamp / now; miner-influenced source used in randomness and events.
address(fundsDistributor).call.gas(30000).value(distribute)(); low-level external call that forwards ETH and can reenter.
players[game][winner].transfer(toPlayer); ETH push to winner address, potential reentrancy vector.
players[game][0].transfer(jackpot[game]); full refund push to the only player.
partner.transfer(sum); ETH push to referral partner.
salesPartner.transfer(sum); ETH push to sales partner.
jackpot[game] * fee / 100 and distribute -= paidToPartners; unchecked multiplication/subtraction in prize math.
distribute * percent / 100; unchecked referral commission multiplication.
jackpot[game] += msg.value; unchecked balance accumulation in buyTicket.
keccak256(time * difficulty * number * uint(bHash)) modulo arithmetic; miner-influenceable randomness computation.
Cryptolotto6Hours(address,address,address,address) public; wires ownable/stats/referral/distributor and starts game.
function() public payable; forwards value to buyTicket(address(0)).
getPlayedGamePlayers() view returns (uint); players count of current game.
getPlayersInGame(uint) view returns (uint); reads players[playedGame].length.
getPlayedGameJackpot() view returns (uint); jackpot of current game.
getGameJackpot(uint) view returns (uint); reads jackpot mapping.
toogleActive() public onlyOwner; toggles isActive / toogleStatus.
start() public onlyOwner; pays previous game then starts a new one.
changeTicketPrice(uint) public onlyOwner; sets newPrice.
randomNumber(uint,uint,uint,uint,uint,bytes32) public pure; pseudo-random derivation helpers.
buyTicket(address) public payable; validates price/status, records player and processes referral.
startGame() internal; sets game number, applies price/status changes, emits Game.
pickTheWinner() internal; selects winner, transfers ETH, calls stats aggregator.
processReferralSystem(address,address) internal; registers referral and pays partners.
transferToPartner(address) internal; computes and pushes partner commission.
transferToSalesPartner(address) internal; computes and pushes sales partner commission.
getPartnerAmount(address) internal view; converts partner percent into ETH amount.
getSalesPartnerAmount(address) internal view; converts sales partner percent into ETH amount.
calculateReferral(uint8) internal view; ticketPrice*fee/100*percent/100 commission math.
modifier onlyOwner(); requires ownable.allowed(msg.sender).
